\cos^2 x + \cos^2 (x + y) - 2 \cos x \cos y \cos (x + y) = \cos^2 x + \cos^2 (x + y) - 2 \cos x \cos y \cos (x + y).
\]

Thus, the simplified expression is:
\[
\boxed{1}.
\]
